question: Across a real recent window of hermit commits, what fraction of the CI suite does affected-test selection (ci/select-tests.rs, #1500/#1529) genuinely skip, and does it narrow for narrow commits while falling back to FULL for shared-code commits?
traversal: git log --first-parent -n 200 (one landed unit per merge/commit)
caveat: Window is CI-tooling-heavy (~80% of FULL is ci/**, validate.sh, .github/** churn that correctly forces full). 43.5% reducible / 14-22% work-saved is a lower bound colored by window composition, not a fixed selector property.
reproduction: python3 sweep.py 200 in dev-hermit; per-commit rows in results.csv; labeled examples via python3 examples.py
